verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents analytics, delivery logs, DMARC monitoring and an MCP server that lets external AI assistants act on the account. None of it shows AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside MailerSend itself. Connecting outside tools like Claude through MCP is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
